source_issue.title: Create Site Manager and Editor Guide for Plone 7

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue focuses on creating a Site Manager and Editor Guide for Plone 7, as current documentation is outdated. The proposal suggests using automated tools for visual documentation—like screenshots and videos—to enhance the guide, making it accessible for users with various language backgrounds.

## What needs to be done
We need to investigate and implement automated tools (Cypress or Playwright) to capture and integrate visual content for the Site Manager and Editor Guide. The goal is to produce a comprehensive and updated manual that includes both narrative text and visual aids.

## Helpful background
The existing documentation for previous Plone versions is inadequate, and reliance on visuals can help describe complex processes that are hard to capture with text alone. However, there are differing opinions on using too many visuals, as this can clutter documentation.

## Good first steps
1. Familiarize yourself with Cypress and Playwright for automated testing and documentation.
2. Explore the current state of Plone documentation and the existing guides, particularly the links shared in the comments (e.g., [Volto User Manual](https://6.docs.plone.org/volto/user-manual/index.html)).
3. Join discussions at PloneConf to understand community needs and possible collaboration.
4. Consider reviewing and repurposing existing training materials to assist with this guide.
```
